component.name: LGL Games Launcher
component.summary: A local Steam library for Fedora

description.p: LGL Games Launcher discovers installed Steam games from local manifests, presents them in a GTK library, and launches them through Steam or the Flatpak Steam client.
This is the Steam-only MVP. Other launchers, emulators, playtime recording, Game Mode, saves, backups and streaming are not part of this build.
Initial Steam-only MVP: discovery, library browsing, details and launch.
